changelog:
v8.0 — the book is now solved as a LINEAR HARVEST PROGRAM: maximise the sum of momentum_strength x weight subject to the volatility budget, the cluster rows and the single-name cap, replacing the v7 chi-square distance-to-target solve. Book size is an OUTPUT rather than a setting: no k, no share bar, no widening rule. The single-name ceiling is 50% of book. Gated against v7.0 on 2026-09-20: panel centre 15.84% -> 18.96% (+3.13pp) with dispersion reduced in all three families (pooled -1.98pp, offsets -2.88pp, cadence -1.16pp); DOMINATES the incumbent on (centre, dispersion) in both families; stress passes on all four execution-date arms where v7.0 fails three; every D6 line passes off-path; absolute floors hold at every arm; 0% of every risk band spent off-path. 237 of 249 rebalances changed. TAIL ACKNOWLEDGED: N=6 trades 4.11pp of worst-12mo for 6.1pp of max drawdown (-31.0% to -24.9%) and converts a stress-gate FAIL to a pass on that arm, while remaining 10.7pp inside the -25% absolute floor; the other two off-path arms improve worst-12mo by +5.2pp and +5.02pp, so the median passes and this is a single-arm trade, not a deterioration.

[major: the solve's objective is a new core mechanism: a linear harvest LP replaces the chi-square solve, and book size becomes an output rather than a configured k]
